This exactly negates the universal norm-convergence target. Archive without assigning an AIM ID; complete-proof correctness is not independently certified here.

further_archive.title: Almost bi-Lipschitz Euclidean embeddings of compact doubling spaces
further_archive.reason: Fukano, arXiv:2610.40601, submitted 29 October 2026, announces almost bi-Lipschitz Euclidean embeddability of every compact doubling metric space, with logarithmic exponent greater than one. This directly matches the unrestricted Margaris-Robinson target. Archive without ID as a matching complete proof announcement; the full proof has not been independently certified.

further_archive.title: Does convexity under every sectionwise contraction characterize ellipsoids?
further_archive.reason: The exact-set formulation admits an elementary boundary counterexample: the open Euclidean unit ball together with one point on its unit sphere. Every positive-measure affine section has the same barycenter as its open-ball section. Contraction yields the interior of the ellipsoid |z|^2+|w|^2/r^2<1, together with at most one boundary point; this is convex for every orthogonal splitting X plus X-perp and every 0<r<1. The original set is neither an open nor a closed ellipsoid. Archive this literal formulation without ID. This does not resolve the intended rigidity question modulo null boundary changes, or the compact-convex-body version.

further_archive.reason: Dinh, Le and Vuong, Positive Planar Measures for Spectral Pinching and the Corrected BMV Conjecture, 22 October 2026, Theorem 4.3 claims for every Hermitian pair the pinching inequality whenever the second-variable second derivative of a scalar polynomial is globally nonnegative. The symmetrized word coefficient is thus nonnegative in every dimension, including k=0 trivially. This exactly implies the submitted even-BMV assertion for indefinite Hermitian matrices.
